LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_GizmoDiveDesc: Flood the ballast tanks and go under, which takes {SECONDS} seconds. Under the water nothing can see the boat or shoot at it, and only an explosion can reach it. It cannot fire most of its guns or land anyone, and it runs down its air and charge, faster on the move.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_GizmoSurfaceDesc: Blow the tanks and come up, which takes {SECONDS} seconds. The boat can be seen from the moment it starts to rise. On the surface it takes on air and charges up again.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseNotSurfaced: {VEHICLE} has to be fully on the surface first.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseCrew: {VEHICLE} does not have enough crew aboard to dive.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefusePart: The {PART} is too badly damaged to dive with. Mend it first.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseReserve: {VEHICLE} needs more air and charge first. Wait on the surface.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseShallow: The water here is too shallow for {VEHICLE} to dive. Every part of the hull has to be over deep water.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_RefuseLanding: {VEHICLE} has to surface before anyone can get out.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_UpEmpty: {VEHICLE} ran out of air and charge and had to surface.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_UpPart: {VEHICLE} had to surface: its {PART} is too badly damaged to stay under.
LanguageData.PhobosSubmersible_UpShallow: {VEHICLE} ran into shallow water and had to surface.
